{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The international community must condemn the use of chemical weapons on civilians in Syria and support the United Nations inspectors’ efforts to discover the perpetrators of such violence.","claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence":"The international community must condemn the use of chemical weapons on civilians in Syria and support the United Nations inspectors’ efforts to discover the perpetrators of such violence."},
{"claim_text":"Even if it is determined that chemical weapons were used by the Assad regime, a unilateral air strike by the United States would not cease that threat.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"But even if it is determined that chemical weapons were used by the Assad regime, a unilateral air strike by the United States would not cease that threat."},
{"claim_text":"U.S. air power cannot surgically take out those individuals who can deploy such weapons.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"U.S. air power cannot surgically take out those individuals who can deploy such weapons."},
{"claim_text":"A U.S. air strike will kill many innocent civilians.","claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence":"What it will do is kill many innocent civilians."},
{"claim_text":"United States troops on the ground only serve to increase the level of violence in civil wars.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"And our experience in Iraq and Afghanistan demonstrates that United States troops on the ground only serve to increase the level of violence in civil wars."}],
"unresolved_references":[]}
